## Checklist

- [ ] `make check` passes
- [ ] Tests cover the change, and coverage stays at or above 90%
- [ ] New critical-path functions have a benchmark, and input parsers a fuzz target
- [ ] Records changed or added pass `canon lint`, and their rules resolve both ways
- [ ] Docs updated (`make docs` regenerates the reference pages)
- [ ] The PR title follows Conventional Commits (`feat:`, `fix:`, `docs:` ...)
